name: pnyx-axi
description: Every agent and its work in Pnyx, with an AXI CLI

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "fs.chmodSync('dist/cli/pnyx-axi.js', 0o755)" && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:web: pnpm run build && node test/web-smoke.ts && node test/panel-smoke.ts && node test/task-smoke.ts && node test/card-states-smoke.ts && node test/done-labels-smoke.ts && node test/context-smoke.ts && node test/codex-host-smoke.ts && node test/permission-smoke.ts && node test/skills-smoke.ts && node test/project-smoke.ts && node test/reminders-smoke.ts
scripts.test:keyboard: pnpm run build && node test/keyboard-smoke.ts && node test/oracle-keyboard-smoke.ts
scripts.test:chat: pnpm run build && node test/chat-smoke.ts && node test/markdown-previews-smoke.ts
